summary: The PocketStation is a memory card peripheral for the PlayStation console made by Sony Computer Entertainment. Sony described it as a combination of a Memory Card and a miniature personal digital assistant, with a monochrome LCD, infrared communication, a real-time clock, built-in flash memory and sound. It works as a memory card only when connected through a PlayStation memory card slot, and it was released exclusively in Japan on January 23, 1999.
one_line: The PocketStation is a Sony memory card peripheral with a monochrome LCD and mini-PDA features for the PlayStation, released in Japan in 1999.
